apiKey.label: Anthropic API key
apiKey.hint: The association's own key, from its account with Anthropic. The AI package makes no calls without one. The key is never shown again once saved: replace it or clear it here.

model.label: Model
model.hint: The larger the model, the better its drafts and the more each call costs on the association's account.

monthlyTokenLimit.label: Monthly limit, in tokens
monthlyTokenLimit.hint: The most the AI package may use in a calendar month, counting what it sends and what it gets back. A token is about four characters of text. Once the limit is reached, the assistants stop until the next month starts. 0 stops them at once.

requestsPerMinute.label: Calls per minute
requestsPerMinute.hint: The most calls to the model the AI package makes in one minute, for the whole association.

site.heading: News and pages
site.intro: Describe what you want to write or change in the association's news and on the website's pages. The assistant puts each change forward as a pending change, and nothing changes until you have read and confirmed it under Pending changes.
site.mailingNote: The assistant cannot send anything to the members. It can request a news mailing, and the mailing goes out only once a board member has answered the request on the news screen.
site.promptLabel: What do you want to write or change?

outcome.cutShort: The answer grew too long and stops part-way.
outcome.tooManyRounds: The assistant did not finish. Ask it to carry on, or break what you want done into smaller parts.
outcome.declined: The assistant declined to answer this.
outcome.failed: Something went wrong on the server. Changes already put forward are listed below.
outcome.repeated: This request had already been answered.
outcome.inProgress: The assistant is still working on this request. Try again in a moment, and you will be shown what it put forward.
outcome.expired: This request was sent too long ago to be answered again. Any changes it put forward are under Pending changes.

refused.host-unsupported: This Open BRF instance is too old for the assistant.
refused.entitlement-required: The association holds no valid licence for the AI package.
refused.provider-not-configured: No API key has been entered in the plugin's settings.
refused.usage-limit-reached: This month's limit for the AI package has been reached. The assistant can be used again when the next month starts.
refused.rate-limited: Too many requests right now. Try again in a minute.
refused.provider-failed: The language model did not answer. Try again in a moment.

error.send: The request could not be sent. Check the connection and try again.
error.forbidden: You may not change the association's news and pages.
